summary: Iteration 16 verifies the HIGH-priority fix flagged in iter 15: ActivityLog::diffOf($model) is now diffOf(Model, array $before) with $before captured BEFORE save() in UserController::update and ProfileController::update. Backend: full pytest suite is GREEN — 70/70 across two consecutive runs (23s and 29s), no flakes. Tightened TestIteration12AuditTrailFeatures::test_user_update_creates_diff_changes so it now strictly asserts change['old']=='QA Diff Original' AND change['new']=='QA Diff Updated' (previously old was only loosely validated because the diff was broken). Also fixed sibling test test_user_password_change_is_masked to filter to the specific PUT /users/{uid} audit row (was picking up delete-snapshot rows where password.new=null due to reordering of top rows now that real diffs exist). Frontend: end-to-end UI flow through Users → Audit Trail → Profile confirms the diff is correct in the real UI. For a create+update+delete cycle of a dedicated Staf user via the UI, the audit-detail Perubahan Data table shows: name 'QA FE Original'→'QA FE Updated', email 'TEST_qa_fe_diff@example.com'→'TEST_qa_fe_diff2@example.com', phone '081234000111'→'081234000222', password '••••••'→'••••••' (masked, no bcrypt/plaintext leak), role 'Staf'→'Super Admin'. Profile update via /profile: name 'Zulfadli Rizal'→'Zulfadli Rizal QA' then reverted; audit rows carry the correct pre-save originals. Delete-snapshot row shows all columns old→null with password masked. Zero console errors on /audit-trail, /audit-trail/{id}, /users, /profile. Branding was again reset to 'AdminKit/AK/Admin panel' between iterations (persists across container resume) — I restored CODEX branding + tagline + brand_initials + meta_title via tinker and cleared cache; recommend the developer add a persistent seed guard so branding survives migrate:fresh or pod resume.
action_items: Persist branding (app_name/tagline/brand_initials/meta_title) so it is not silently reset to defaults across pod resumes; consider a seeder or config guard that reapplies CODEX values if the settings row is absent.
critical_code_review_comments: ActivityLog::diffOf(Model, array $before) is the right shape: forcing callers to pass the pre-save originals prevents Eloquent's syncOriginal() from silently corrupting the audit trail. Consider also removing 'password' from getChanges() in diffOf() early to make masking robust even if MASKED is edited.

For the destroy snapshot, columns whose value never changed still appear with old=<val>, new=null; that is fine for delete-semantics but consider filtering ignored keys (id, email_verified_at when null, avatar when null, last_login_at when null) to reduce noise in the /audit-trail/{id} UI.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — /users create+update+delete, /profile update+revert, /audit-trail listing, /audit-trail/{id} detail all render with zero console errors; diff values match submitted before/after exactly; password '••••••'; role change recorded

context_for_next_testing_agent: Diff feature is now fully working end-to-end. Backend suite is 70/70 stable and strict (old asserted, not just new). If iterating on this feature, remember the previously-observed sequencing gotcha: the delete-snapshot audit row also has a 'password' key with new=null (correct behavior for a delete), so any test scanning latest rows for 'password' in changes must filter by method=PUT/PATCH and the target /users/{uid} URL — this is already done in test_user_password_change_is_masked. Also note: branding tends to get reset to defaults between iterations; run the tinker restore block from seed_data_creation before UI branding checks.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause (iter 15): ActivityLog::diffOf($model) called $model->getOriginal($key) AFTER $model->save(); Eloquent's save() invokes syncOriginal() so 'original' == 'new', making every audit diff old==new. Fix (iter 16): change signature to diffOf(Model $model, array $before) where $before = $model->getOriginal() is captured before save(); UserController::update and ProfileController::update now capture $before prior to fill/save. Verified live: /audit-trail/{id} for a real user update shows genuine pre→post values for every changed column, with MASKED columns rendered as '••••••' on both sides.
